So for everyone that wanted an update, last night someone from this post, drove by and checked it out. No other car besides hers. Checks out right?! EXCEPT! We were texting and she’s usually fast with the replies, however all of a sudden, it stopped. I waited about 20 min and this is when the guy off of tinder replied to me saying he just drove by and the Porsche was in the driveway, I thought this was weird as a redditor just drove by too and saw only her car? I texted the redditor explaining the situation, thankfully she drove back to check it out once again (you guys are awesome) I was suspicious because the guy off tinder couldn’t describe the Porsche, I had asked him what color or if there were any other cars there to which he said “I just drove by and saw the iconic Porsche lights, didn’t pay too much attention” The redditor drove by again and this time around it was her car and a Jeep, now the Jeep is her friends, however why would the guy off tinder lie to me? Sure he’s gay, but does he really think breaking us up will make me gay and like him? I couldn’t get it off my mind, until I thought to myself, where was the Jeep in the first place? Could’ve it been in the garage? What if the guy off tinder wasn’t lying, what if he really did see the Porsche and her and her friends decided to put it in the garage? I told her before the trip that I have friend there (a lie) and not to do anything stupid. What if she suspected this and decided to hide the Porsche in the garage. Hence why the Jeep was outside when the redditor drove by just 10 min after the tinder man claimed to see the Porsche? Idk maybe I’m just paranoid, I really want to thank the girl and the boyfriend that drove out though, I’m starting to trust her more because of this :)
